narrative: Material PL1__MFE6E487 shows erratic but fully continuous daily demand averaging 1,457 units with a CV of 0.434 and volatile replenishment lead times (CV=0.527, mean=2.48 days). The SAP safety stock of 1,339 units is statistically insufficient to achieve the 95% service level target; the data-driven optimum is 3,316 units. A continuous-review (r,Q) policy with ROP=8,764 and Q=6,288 is recommended — storage capacity is respected at 79.7% utilization, and no MOQ infeasibility exists.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Demand is erratic but always positive (non-zero fraction = 100%), making a continuous-review model appropriate. EOQ minimizes total ordering and holding costs; the MOQ of 98 units is non-binding as EOQ >> MOQ. Continuous review is justified by the volatile lead times that require prompt reorder triggers.
